scenario.suspicion_context: You are an outsider in the office, and your presence has raised questions among the staff. You claim to be a contractor, but your story doesn't quite add up.
scenario.player_backstory: You claim to be a contractor here to fix a server room fan that's been causing issues. You say a colleague sent you, but their name doesn't match any employee records.

clues.name: Access Terminal Log
clues.description: A terminal showing recent access attempts to restricted areas.
detail_points: Valid login attempts only from internal IPs
No record of your login credentials
clues.supports: If legitimate, could show you were given access by an employee.

clues.name: Intercepted Email
clues.description: A printed email from an unknown sender to 'security@company.com'.
clues.supports: Neutral—doesn’t directly help or hurt your case.

clues.name: Keycard for Restricted Area
clues.description: A keycard programmed for access to the server room.
detail_points: No record of your name in the system
clues.supports: If found on you, could suggest unauthorized access.

clues.name: Work Order Request
clues.description: A document requesting maintenance on the server room fan.
clues.supports: If legitimate, could explain your presence.

clues.name: Network Switch
clues.description: A network switch with an asset tag.

clues.name: Two Coffee Mugs
